segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: My father opened this place in nineteen seventy-eight, and I have been behind this counter for twenty-two years.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up

segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: Small businesses like this one employ almost half of the private workforce in this country.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up

segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: We pay the federal minimum wage here, seven dollars and twenty-five cents an hour. It has not changed since two thousand nine.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up

segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: There are more than a hundred and fifty thousand convenience stores in this country now, and nearly all of them sell coffee.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up

segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: We do about two hundred cups a day. Ten years ago it was closer to three hundred.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up

segments.speaker: Owner, Harrow Bend Coffee
segments.transcript: Off the record, we are signing a lease on a second location next month. It has not been announced, so please do not use that on air.
segments.visual_summary: Interview with the owner across the counter, medium shot from the chest up
